text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Jones Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of an on-street accessible parking space on the east side of Jones Avenue.

City Council on March 25 and 26, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council designate an on-street accessible parking space to be in effect at all times on the east side of Jones Avenue, between a point 38 metres south of Ravina Crescent and a point 5.5 metres further south.
